# highperapp/cache

> 标签: amphp, async, cache, high-performance, memcached, php-uv, redis, rust-ffi

## 简介

High-performance caching library with Rust FFI acceleration and AMPHP async support

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。
